definitions.gloss: tie score; both sides having equal points
definitions.explanation: a situation where both teams or competitors have the same score

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{同点|どうてん}で{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The game ended in a tie.

examples.japanese: {後半|こうはん}に{同点|どうてん}に{追|お}いついた。
examples.english: They tied the game in the second half.

examples.japanese: 3{対|たい}3の{同点|どうてん}から{延長戦|えんちょうせん}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: They went into overtime from a 3-3 tie.

notes:
SPORTS TERM:
{同点|どうてん} combines {同|どう} (same) + {点|てん} (points). Used in all scored sports.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同点|どうてん}に{追|お}いつく - to tie the game (catch up)
- {同点|どうてん}で{終|お}わる - to end in a tie
- {同点|どうてん}ゴール - tying goal
- {同点|どうてん}ホームラン - game-tying home run

SCORE REPORTING:
- 2{対|たい}2の{同点|どうてん} - tied at 2-2
- 0{対|たい}0の{同点|どうてん} - scoreless tie

RELATED TERMS:
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}け - draw (game result)
- {先制点|せんせいてん} - opening score
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん} - reversal
- {延長戦|えんちょうせん} - overtime/extra time
